Results.ReviewText:
My daughter has stage III cancer. It is Florida in July and August. The kettle is still in the 
living room.  Ask me again in November after we start using it. Thank you
Results.Title: Give me some time to use the kettle.

Results.ReviewText: Classic, simple and easy all around. Can't get better than the original!
Results.Title: 3rd or 4th over 50 years

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love the Weber kettle I got for myself. My old man always used Weber himself, and it was time I got one and it’s been great
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po

Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill....have not used my inside kitchen since my grill arrived
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: This is a wonderful grill. The kettle design is perfect for so many styles of cooking!
Results.Title: A Really Fine Grill

Results.ReviewText: Everything I have cooked on this thing has been absolutely amazing. Just a unbelievable piece of grilling equipment.  Top to bottom it is flawless!
Results.Title: A must buy for any true grilling enthusiast!

Results.ReviewText: Just purchased this about 2 weeks ago. Previously had a gas grill and decided to change. We are still getting use to heat adjustment and have just used it for basic hamburgers, hotdogs and roasted asparagus, cauliflower and broccoli. It was very easy to put together by following the instructions. Looking forward to trying my luck with some ribs and brisket.
Results.Title: Kettle Goodness

Results.ReviewText: Very good reliable grill.  The hook to put the lid on is hard to find sometimes, though.
Results.Title: Dependable grill!

Results.ReviewText: So far I made Carne Asada, lemon pepper chicken and a Tri tip roast. everything has turned out great.
Results.Title: first week

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to use, quick star and maintains temperature very well
Results.Title: Smgrill

Results.ReviewText: Everything works and works well - temp gauge is handy and the sealed cleaning system is a huge improvement over the original version that had just an open tray.
Results.Title: Simple but effective

Results.ReviewText: very well made,love the ash pan no more ash mess on the ground,Thermometer is also a plus.the thing i don't like is trying to find a cover it that won't sun fade and leak water through it from rain.
Results.Title: 22" charcoal kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill that my daughter bought for me. Cooked some St Louis style ribs right away. Maintains temperature and cleans up well. Love it.
Results.Title: Happy Chef

Results.ReviewText:
I have wanted a Weber grill for a long time and now that I have one, I have used it at least 3 times a week!  Still figuring out what accessories I need but so far the grill by itself is great!
Prior to this purchase, I have tried just about every cheap charcoal grill there is.  The key word there is CHEAP.  Even though the Weber is a little more expensive, the quality and workmanship is far superior and with the cover, will last for years!  Very happy with my purchase!
Results.Title: So happy I finally saved up and got one!

Results.ReviewText: I only use Weber grills because they last. I tell people I have my name on my grill. I moved up from the small kettle and couldn't be happier! It matches my Genesis 4 burner. Lots of space and my favorite part is the ash trap and bottom vent controls. I always depended on my gas grill and I was scared of charcoal long burns and smoking. But this kettle makes it easy.
Results.Title: Great kettle for direct and indirect burns

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a new and reasonably priced charcoal grill.  I saw the review in The NY Times which rates this grill as the best value in its class.  I do not regret my purchase.  I wanted to learn how to grill ribs and make pulled pork.  I found recipes on the Weber site and gave it a try.  I bought a good blue tooth temperature probe and the charcoal holders for indirect grilling.  Now my family thinks I’m an expert pit master.  They  ask me what I’m going to cook next.  Thanks, Weber!
Results.Title: Tried and true excellence

Results.ReviewText: My first grill and I don’t have any complaints. The fit and finish of the grill are good but we did have some trouble putting it together. One of the legs of the grill just wouldn’t fit easily. But I otherwise it’s good and I mainly use it for grilling fish.
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: I have owned many Weber products for over forty years, they last and last. I replaced my Original Kettle , (after approximately 15 years), with the Premium model. It was a perfect fit for my pocketbook and my deck. When my local True Value offered this on sale, I didn't hesitate to purchase and retire my other Weber.
Results.Title: Quality: You know what you're getting with a Weber
Results.UserNickname: Jeff H Lake of the Ozarks

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together. Excellent quality. Cooks great.
Results.Title: Excellent as always

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic cooker, great quality. You can do everything with this one grill. Smoke to sear!
Results.Title: Value!!!

Results.ReviewText: does what I want it to and from the YouTube videos way more than I am capable of now.  Love cooking over charcoal, the food tastes way better than on gas.
Results.Title: Love Charcoal Cooking

Results.ReviewText: This has the great upgrade features I like.  It has the P shaped vents on the bowl for better heat control, the tool holders on the handle, the great ash catcher, larger protected lid vent, the lid thermometer and the upgraded cooking grate that is hinged for adding charcoal during the cook.  A great. long-lasting value !
Results.Title: Excellent upgrade from the original kettle

Results.ReviewText: Awesome Grill! I upgraded from a cheapie from Wal-Mart. What a difference! Holds temp, less burn on my lump coal or charcoal. Wish I would have bought this years ago.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I'm excited to continue to put great food on my table from a Great Grill, my Weber Kettle 💯
Results.Title: There's no Other

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear about your experience with the missing parts and damage. This is not the way we want our valued Weber fans to feel. Our Care team will be reaching out to see how we can help. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText:
Frustrating day…. bought a Weber grill today for $139…. brought it home and attempted to put it together, but the parts needed for the initial steps were missing. Returned to the store—- and the only one left had missing parts, too. So, Lowes offered a deal on the Premium grill as an exchange which we took. So, returned home and began to put the new grill together and found that the grills were crooked as well as the handle. The kettle top did not fit on the bottom part as it should either!!!
Disappointed because we bought our chicken to cook on the grill tonite for dinner. 
Poor quality workmanship, Weber! Very disappointed!
Results.Title: Not what it usedto be

Results.ReviewText: Really simple. Nice control of temperature. A great value in my opinion.
Results.Title: Really enjoying cooking on my new grill

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. We are very sorry to hear about your experience. This is not the way we want our valued Weber fans to feel. We are here to help. Our Care team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: It lasted about two weeks.  First thunderstorm sent it flying and damaged the lid.  I bought it to replace a Weber Spirit gas grill that began leaking gas in a way I could not find to fix  (not from the regulator) after a couple of years.  Save your money and get something more solid that will last.  I wish I did.
Results.Title: Weber is not what it used to be

Results.ReviewText: Always preffered charcoal to gas. Always wondered about the difference between Weber and other Charcoal grils.  Weber hands down! Gave my gas grill to my son in law!
Results.Title: Best Grill Period

Results.ReviewText: I've had my Original Kettle Premium grill for about 4 months and have been using it at least once a week.  The improvements over the standard model are very functional.  This is an excellent grill and I recommend it without hesitation.
Results.Title: Has Everything I Want In A Grill

Results.ReviewText: Tried and true, best cooking results every time! Love Weber products, fit and finish is super and they last.
Results.Title: Weber is the worlds best bbq

Results.ReviewText: These grills are so versatile. I love mine, they can cook, grill, smoke whatever your heart desires
Results.Title: Cooper kettle

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and for choosing a Weber grill! We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the damaged lid. Your satisfaction is very important to us!

Our Care team sent a follow-up email to confirm that your new lid arrived in better condition. Thank you again and happy grilling!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Grill showed up with a damaged lid. Waiting on replacement
Results.Title: Damaged in shipping

Results.ReviewText: Weber Grills are simple to use, produce consistent results, and the rest of my family will only use this grill. This model was a bargain in that it has the ash removal tool and grates which allow easy addition of charcoal. The only downside is the hook to rest the top on the side of the grill is hard to use. It might pay customers who like "easy" to get the more expensive models which allow the top to tilt and rest one the side with wires.
Results.Title: Bargin

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, i got coal grates for slow cooks and smoking . Making a grill cart for it for easy movement and storage
Results.Title: 22" Weber Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: So far so good. Replaced old Weber after 28 years of service
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
